analysis.headline: Nvidia CEO resigns amid Chinese spy affair, reinstatement push rejected
analysis.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO after admitting an affair tied to an alleged Chinese intelligence operation, with further affairs, lawsuits, a congressional summons and a reinstatement campaign backed by Trump and Musk following. Nvidia's board named Colette Kress interim CEO and said it will not bring Huang back.
